title: Cage n(19,6): a 19-regular graph of girth 6 with few vertices
statement: Find a 19-regular simple graph whose girth (shortest cycle) is at least 6, with as few vertices n as possible; it shows n(19,6) <= n (cages grow with the girth). The best known (k,g)-graph in the House of Graphs cage table has 720 vertices [AFLN06]; a graph with fewer vertices improves it.
submission: Text file: one graph in graph6 or sparse6 (as House of Graphs gives them; an optional >>graph6<< or >>sparse6<< header is allowed), or an edge list, one edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered from 0.
score: n, the number of vertices of a 19-regular graph of girth at least 6 (smaller is better)
